VARIANT A1 The epicenter is the immutable Diagram revision model plus CanvasHistory and MappingDocumentController. Browser editing, agent commands, isolated generation, change proposals, and evaluations converge on these structures. Eleven selected points capture that shared core, its persistence boundary, and its principal consumers.
POINT diagram Immutable Diagram Model Diagram combines versioned ASCII content, parsed nodes, source evidence, highlights, and jumps. Revision operations preserve logical node identities while validating edits. This is the fundamental value shared by rendering, agents, history, and storage; parser versions also protect existing node references. REL []
POINT canvas Canvas Commands and History CanvasHistory separates diagram revision bindings from composition, personal view state, and saved CanvasViews. MappingDocumentController applies version-checked semantic operations and coordinates checkpoints, alternatives, transfers, and navigation. Browser sessions and isolated server-side canvases reuse this boundary. REL [('diagram', 'binds immutable revisions into canvas checkpoints')]
POINT editor Interactive Canvas Editor MappingPage assembles the workspace and command receivers. CanvasSession publishes committed state through focused stores, while the tldraw runtime owns live geometry and native undo navigation. Settled gestures become controller commands; rendering, selection, and routing derive from the same semantic document. REL [('canvas', 'commits semantic edits and restores checkpoints'), ('persistence', 'submits workspace changes and flushes acknowledged mutations'), ('source', 'opens mapped source through repository services')]
POINT persistence Durable Canvas Persistence Persistence separates immutable diagram/checkpoint records from mutable catalogs and workspace manifests. Browser-side change tracking sends record batches rather than complete histories. Server adapters validate versions and retry receipts, write referenced records first, and publish manifests or catalogs afterward. REL [('canvas', 'stores and restores checkpoint graphs and workspace records'), ('diagram', 'persists immutable revisions behind content-addressed references')]
POINT api HTTP and MCP Boundary The Vite adapter exposes application services through HTTP, streaming responses, and live sockets. Bootstrap is the concrete composition root. The MCP server translates tool calls into these HTTP endpoints, making this the principal external access boundary rather than a separate implementation of canvas behavior. REL [('live-agent', 'dispatches canvas tools and attaches live readers'), ('generation', 'exposes chat and generation operations'), ('source', 'serves source files and definition lookups'), ('persistence', 'exposes workspace batches and canvas publication'), ('changes', 'exposes proposal workflows and push intake'), ('evals', 'exposes evaluation and comparison services')]
POINT live-agent Live Canvas Agent Protocol AgentDiagrammingSessionService binds tools to specific canvases and documents, validates requests, and manages retry-safe execution. Commands travel through a polling bridge to the browser; a separate live service distributes selection/context updates over sockets. Compact projections and revision guards keep agent references tied to the correct state. REL [('editor', 'dispatches bound browser commands and receives live state'), ('changes', 'redirects scoped reads and mutations into proposal sessions'), ('context', 'uploads and resolves scoped agent context')]
POINT generation Agent Chat and Generation Agent Chat manages persistent conversations, native Codex events, tool bindings, and independent canvas alternatives. Diagram edit and batch services validate generated revisions before application. Codex stdio and Pi runtimes are distinct execution adapters; GenerationCanvasBridge gives child generations isolated controllers using the normal canvas command contract. REL [('live-agent', 'invokes canvas tools through bound sessions'), ('canvas', 'creates isolated controllers for generated alternatives'), ('diagram', 'validates and submits generated revision edits'), ('context', 'reuses captured conversations and pinned source context')]
POINT context Reusable Agent Context AgentContext captures immutable conversation trajectories and source constituents. The library adds durable identities, lineage, grouping, and retry-safe creation; transient uploads remain workspace/document scoped. Diagram-bound contexts and source snapshots make this a shared input boundary for edits, chat alternatives, and evaluations. REL [('source', 'captures source ranges from registered corpus bindings'), ('persistence', 'stores shared immutable source blobs'), ('diagram', 'compiles contexts from diagram evidence and revision identity')]
POINT source Repository Evidence and Navigation Source access resolves an explicit diagram or source binding rather than assuming one repository per project. Corpus providers handle filesystem reads, the repository registry handles Git identities, and optional language services resolve definitions. Browser repository and source panes consume this boundary to connect diagrams back to code. REL [('diagram', 'resolves mappings, evidence, and source bindings'), ('persistence', 'loads registered sources and saved representation bindings')]
POINT changes Repository Change Proposals ChangeSessionService captures repository-scoped canvases and Git hunks into isolated proposals, applies the shared controller operations, and retains baseline/proposed history for review. Acceptance checks captured versions before atomic catalog publication. DiffSession workflows and deduplicated push intake feed this same proposal lifecycle. REL [('canvas', 'forks histories and applies shared controller operations'), ('persistence', 'publishes accepted canvases and recovery receipts'), ('live-agent', 'uses agent tools during proposal materialization')]
POINT evals Evaluation and Comparison Workflows Evaluation runs pin prompt versions, contexts, and canvas checkpoints before generation. Materializers turn validated results into canvas outputs; comparison sessions preserve independent input copies. Experiments, judgements, and promotion build on these records, making this a substantial consumer of the shared model rather than a parallel diagram system. REL [('canvas', 'pins and materializes independent canvas histories'), ('context', 'loads immutable generation inputs'), ('persistence', 'publishes promoted outputs into project catalogs'), ('generation', 'reconciles chat-generated alternatives into evaluation records'), ('changes', 'captures proposal sessions as evaluation outputs')]

import json
for v in json.load(open('variants.json')):
 print('\\nVARIANT',v['variantId'])
 for o in v['outputs']:
  ds=o['canvas']['diagrams']; ls=ds[0]['ascii'].splitlines()
  branches=[s for s in ls if s.startswith(('|--','"'`--'"'))]
  ts=[s for s in o['tree']['ascii'].splitlines() if s.startswith(('|--','"'`--'"'))]

  print('PANELS', '; '.join(d['ascii'].splitlines()[0] for d in ds[1:]),'CROSS',cross)
PY"
